headline: Economic Development Commission to discuss Lofts at Fairgrounds and South County Commons District 5 Apartments preliminary plans, plus URI medical school and SMART Committee work.
summary: The commission will review preliminary plan applications for Lofts at Fairgrounds and South County Commons District 5 Apartments. Members will also discuss the Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Plan, a future URI medical school, resuming SMART Committee statistical work, and collaboration with other town boards.
items: Follow-up discussion on Tour of Westerly State Training Facility
Follow-up discussion on Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Plan and Council consideration of Form Based Code
Discussion of absorbing SMART Committee statistical analysis work into EDC
General discussion about working with URI on a future URI Medical School
Discussion of EDC collaboration with other town boards
Staff update on Lofts at Fairgrounds preliminary plan application
Staff update on South County Commons District 5 Apartments preliminary plan application
Discussion of EDC survey data collection, results, and next steps
Continued discussion of South Kingstown Garden Show concept
New discussion issues and future agenda items
location: Town Hall Council Chambers, 180 High Street, Wakefield, RI

Unless otherwise noted, the EDC may discuss and/or act upon each item on this agenda.  
A. Call to Order & Roll Call 
B. Approval of Minutes: 
 1. 9/2/2026 Draft Minutes 
C. Correspondence & Public Comment: 
Presentation by staff of any correspondence issued or received by the EDC since the previous meeting & receipt 
of any public comment of a general nature that is not connected to a current agenda item. No action will be taken 
by the EDC on any correspondence or comment not specifically referenced in the agenda. 
D. Old Business: 
 1. Tour of Westerly State Training Facility - Follow-Up Discussion 
 2. Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Plan - Follow-up discussion on Council consideration of Form Based 
Code. 
E. New Business: 
 1. Absorption of SMART Committee Work into EDC - Discussion of resuming the statistical analysis work 
formerly delegated to the SMART Committee. 
 2. Future URI Medical School - General discussion about working with URI. 
 3. EDC Collaboration With Other Town Boards 
F. Staff Update & Planning Department Activities: 
Presentation by staff of any new project applications received by the Planning Department and any activities by 
the Planning Department with potential economic impacts for the town. No action will be taken by the EDC on 
any information presented by staff unless specifically referenced in the agenda. 
 1. Lofts at Fairgrounds - Preliminary Plan application received by Planning Dept. 
 2. South County Commons District 5 Apartments - Preliminary Plan application received by Planning Dept. 
G. Recurring Discussion Topics: 
 1. EDC Surveys - Discussion regarding survey data collection, results & next steps. 
 2. South Kingstown Garden Show - Continued discussion of conceptual event.
